verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs show dense and sparse vector search, BM25 full-text search, multi-queries intended for hybrid search, and server-side rank fusion via RRF plus native reranking. Together these deliver dense-plus-keyword hybrid retrieval with fusion ranking. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid queries, and detail on fusion configuration (e.g., weighting, or fusing dense with sparse vectors specifically) beyond brief doc snippets.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote: Vector search, >90% recall, combined with any filters, dense & sparse
turbopuffer supports BM25 full-text search for string and []string types
turbopuffer also provides server-side rank fusion via RRF and native reranking with managed models.
Multi-queries: send multiple queries to the same namespace used for hybrid searches.
